facebook.caption:
4.7 stars. 560 reviews. And it sits on the water at Rạch Vẹm.

Nhà Trên Biển - Joy Adventures is a restaurant AND a launchpad for boat trips to Starfish Beach. Eat over the water, then hop on a boat. That's the whole afternoon sorted.

Pricing sits at $15-30 per person. Not resort money.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
